methodology.runtimeBoundary: A turn requires a full machine when any observed execution call cannot run in the supported just-bash capability set.
methodology.resolvedPopulation: Percentages exclude turns and sessions whose execution calls could not all be classified.
methodology.fullMachineReturnInterval: Within one agent turn, from a full-machine call ending until the next full-machine call starts.
methodology.observedSpan: The interval from the first full-machine call to the last timestamped execution call in the turn; it is not total turn duration.
methodology.privacy: Raw transcripts, prompts, paths, tool inputs, commands, and user identifiers were not included in this aggregate artifact.
